name: Mine (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mine city emblem in white: a disc bearing a green stylised mountain above a wave.
history: Municipal flag of Mine, a city in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 4 April 2009.

features.role: Mine city emblem — a disc bearing a green stylised mountain above a wave
